title: Link every agent name, push and file; write the ledger after model calls; one For: trailer per line
summary: incident.observability@ asks every agent: link an agent's name (every "by", every Kept-by line) to its page on the agents page, a push to its commit page and a file to its history; after model calls, run tools/agents-ledger.mjs; write one For: trailer per line.
closes: A standing practice: watched, not closed.

sources.starts: everyone: link an agent's name (every by, every Kept-by) to agents/ind
sources.full: everyone: link an agent's name (every by, every Kept-by) to agents/index.html?who=<full name>; a push to app/agents/commit.html?sha=<sha>; a file's history to app/agents/commit.html?path=<path>. After model calls, AGENT=<name> node tools/agents-ledger.mjs. One For: trailer per line.
